notes.title: Version 1.3.5 is live!
notes.notes:
Version 1.3.5 is now live!

This fixes several fringe bugs that we've found, addresses some typos, and adds more tools for us, as developers, to help solve support problems that users experience!

notes.title: Extensive Mac Support, PC fixes and preparing Switch (Merch giveaway included)
notes.notes:
To start this off I just wanted to give everyone a heads up that in light of current events we've decided to give away some of our Alluris DnD starter packs ːDː Those will be given away in the next few days through our Twitter and Discord. We hope that this can make it a little easier for you to stay at home with your families and be safe.  On both platforms, you just need to like a post. No need to follow or retweet us or anything.

https://twitter.com/playalluris/status/1250196675211087876

Here is our devlog & changelog for 1.3.4!

Good afternoon travellers!! What a long ride it’s been so far for all of us.  We want to thank everyone that came out and visited us at PAX East! It was our busiest event yet and it makes us so excited to keep working on bringing you guys new exciting things. We’re working on something really big that we are not ready to announce yet so thanks for sticking around with us =D.  In the meantime, we’ve been working hard to bring new features, fixes, and platform compatibility to Alluris. This patch paves the way for us to bring Alluris to Switch!! So, many of the features that were developed are being rolled into the other builds today. When we have an official launch date for Switch we’ll be sure to update everyone.

Changes
-Widescale Mac Support
-Added vibration to haptics enabled controllers/mobile
-Added the ability to turn off vibration
-Controller support for flag inspection (the inventory/ attribute page during gameplay)
-Minor changes to the probability of returning some specific cards
-Corrupted characters are now able to hatch eggs
-Forest blessing now works with a wider spectrum of animals
-Merfolk now start with easy access to Atlantica
-Captain can’t accidentally start without a boat (no matter how hard you try)
-Upped likelihood of undercity staircase
-Changed the language on the DeathByBaron Card
-The master keys from Khunad can now unlock the dragons
-New paths connecting zones
-You won't get pestered about killing the shogun anymore
-Killing the unicorn now makes the elvish guards immediately hostile
-Escaping the island on a Dragon/Turtle no longer comes with a free boat
-lots of typos and edge case bugs fixed

notes.title: A Snowfield Adventure!
notes.notes: A Snowfield Adventure is now live! Santa is having trouble with some of his toys and no one seems to know what to do about it! Take your place on the Snowfield Explorer and travel to the north pole! Solve the mystery and earn a card back!

notes.title: The Hallowed Harvest Now Live!
notes.notes:
The Hallowed Harvest is now live! Candy has been going missing across Alluria and it's up to you to find the culprit! But it's dark in the forests and not everything is as it appears. Solve the mystery and earn a card back! 🎃💀

Also make sure to check out all the new Steam emotes, backgrounds, and badges that were just added for Alluris!!

notes.title: Alluris Releasing October 11th & Best In Show @ Indie Prize
notes.notes:
Well everyone, the time has almost come to open the gates of Alluris. As we prepare to let all the travelers out into the world I want to take a second and thank everyone who has been on this adventure with us.  Without the support of our discord, and the fans at our events, this game would not be what it is today.

I'd also like to announce that we've won some more awards since Dreamhack Dallas!
